text:
Maya P: FYI calibration scheduling conflict: 6 of our 12 panelists are double-booked because the quarterly all-hands was rescheduled into the same slot. We need a quick mitigation plan so this doesn't delay handbacks + final grades.

Amanda R: Ugh. Options: 1) move the whole calibration by 24h, 2) split the panel into two shorter sessions same day, 3) run asynchronous review + recon sync. We should pick the one that preserves fairness and minimizes churn. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

People Ops Bot: Reminder: calibration exports freeze at panel start_time. Any shift must be reflected in export_cutoff and audit logs.

Theo W: Data point: with current roster, 6 unavailable -> quorum would be borderline. Splitting into two panels keeps momentum but requires a deterministic merge process for scores.

Jess M: I like split panels same day if we can guarantee a merging protocol. People hate moving calendars. We'll need: anchor set of reviewees reviewed by both panels, a reconciliation rubric, and a short merge facilitator doc. I can draft the facilitator checklist.

Raj P: Operational constraints: exports and handback automation need a single canonical cutoff. If we split, we must run export after both sessions and mark which rows came from panel A vs B. Eng will need a `panel_id` field in the calibration export.

Nina L: Merge idea: pick ~10% of reviews as overlap (anchor set) so we can measure inter-panel variance. Reconcile by median-shift if average delta < threshold, else run tie-breaker adjudication with calibration leads. Keep it simple.

Amanda R: Agree on anchor set + simple reconcile rule. Also cap split panels to same UTC day to avoid timezone unfairness. We should avoid moving the whole event unless unavoidable.

People Ops Bot: Task created: TASK-6301 "Calibration split + merge protocol". Assigned to people-ops and eng.

Theo W: I'll coordinate with Eng to add `panel_id`, `is_anchor=true|false`, and `export_pending_merge` columns to the export. ETA: 3h.

Jess M: I'll run a Doodle/poll now with options: "split same day (preferred)" / "move 24h" / "asynchronous". Link: https://poller.example/s/CalOpts. Also drafting the facilitator checklist: short items: start with rubric recap, review anchor set, record deltas, apply median-shift if needed, escalate if >2 sigma.

Maya P: Poll results in: 8 prefer split same day, 4 prefer move 24h. Consensus = split. Please proceed with split + anchor approach.

Raj P: Noted. I'll update the handback automation to hold exports until both panel slots complete and set `export_cutoff` to the later panel end. We'll add audit header: `split_panel_merge=TASK-6301`.

Amanda R: Jess, please notify calibration leads, panelists, and managers with the final schedule and include the facilitator checklist + anchor list. Also add a runbook note: "if calibration split, set anchor 10% and use median-shift reconcile".

Jess M: Sending comms now. Subject line: "Updated: Calibration split same day + merge protocol (ACTION: facilitators)". Includes checklist, anchor selection, and escalation path.

People Ops Bot: TASK-6301 update: Eng accepted schema changes (PR #4983), export fields added. Schedule updated at 1855012850.

Amanda R: Thanks team. Post-action: let's capture metrics after this run (inter-panel variance on anchor set) and decide if anchor size should change. Closing plan here; tracking in TASK-6301. :white_check_mark:
